verdict.rationale: There is evidence of structured data submission for incorporation (company details, shareholders, directors) and a digital tax registration questionnaire submitted via ELSTER, which resembles guided form-filling, but nothing describes a questionnaire flow that validates legal choices or flags items requiring attorney review — the process instead routes to real notaries for the legal check, not an in-app flagging mechanism. Missing for 10: evidence of a structured Q&A/questionnaire UI, logic that flags legally risky choices, and any attorney-review escalation feature.
